bio: A pleasantly straightforward concept that goes down well with restaurant-goers. The seasonal and internationally influenced cuisine is served in a friendly, modern atmosphere. The à la carte menu is complemented by daily specials on the board. At lunchtime, there is an additional dish of the day. For those with a sweet tooth, the counter displaying fine home-made pastries is a highlight! Attentive service. The terrace – in a traffic-calmed area here in the middle of the city – is also pleasant. There is a pretty holiday apartment for overnight stays....
